decision_heading: ## Organized mind: product brief and design approved (2026-10-14)
decision_body:
**Decision:** Huy approved the organized-mind product brief and design spec as a whole ("Approve as whole", relayed by the pi-mind conductor session). Documents: `data/intake/kbu-2026-10-07/product-brief.md`, `design-spec.md`.
**Open choices:** 13 of 14 answered (log.md, 2026-10-14). 1: pi-mind is one repo for the harness side (extension, bundle server, memory server, plan-goal); the knowledge base and archive keep their own repos, joined by one shared interface and one installer. 2: this Mac hosts the memory writer and all infrastructure; bppc hosts only the LLM engine. 3–9, 11–14: as recommended (4–7, 11–13 via "Ok to rest"). 10 (speed acceptance ratio) stays open until query latency is measured on the Mac.
**Related:** embedding switch to embeddinggemma-2 at 768 dims on today's chunk files, pending the M1c re-gate; graph extraction to be tested with LFM2.5-24B-A2B (unit M4).
log_lines_241_242: - 2026-10-14 13:30: Huy's answers on open decisions. B: switch live search to Gemma 768 = yes. C: use today's chunk files (not restored v10 payloads). Part 2: 1 = separate repos + one interface/installer (R6 C); 2 = this Mac hosts the writer and all infrastructure, bppc only the LLM engine; 3 = start coverage on one current task; 8 = testable subset first; 9 = keep 300 ms provisional; 10 = wait for Mac measurement; 14 = accept pre-registered scoring. Asked for explanation: A (why ~5,430 h graph), 4, 5, 6, 7, 11, 12, 13. M1b launched (resumed M1 codex thread, CPU only on bppc, 8 threads): rebuild kbu_m1_gemma768_cur from today's chunk files and re-gate.

- 2026-10-14: Huy: A (graph) → test a smaller model, LFM2.5-24B-A2B, with a quant that fits entirely on the RTX 5080. "Ok to rest" = accept recommendations for 4 (bounded scope, freeze GPU-hour ceiling first), 5 (page links + separate figure search, one-subject trial), 6 (Huy reviews candidates via review queue), 7 (mechanical facts closed by recorded recheck; guidance by Huy), 11 (6,000-token cap for the answer-benefit experiment only), 12 (review all lessons from first 20 tasks), 13 (one retry, receipt check first, outbox). M4 brief written (checks/brief-M4.md); quants QAD-Q4_0 (13.58 GB) and UD-Q3_K_XL (10.95 GB) downloading to bppc; M4 waits for pi-mind's GPU release.
clarification: Gary choice 1: pi-mind owns the harness side; KB and archive keep their own repos; one shared interface and installer. Choice 2: Mac runs harness, writer and infrastructure; bppc only the sandboxed LLM engine.
